meta.description:
This is a guided loving kindness meditation that begins with yourself and opens to every kind of mind. You will be given four simple wishes, and a quiet turn to receive them.

For World Kindness Day. Kindness here reaches past friends to strangers, and to every kind of mind.

A Buddhist loving-kindness meditation that widens goodwill from yourself to every kind of mind, with phrases that hold whether or not anything is felt.
